newsitem.title: USA: Maine study says state should lure retirees.
newsitem.headline: Maine study says state should lure retirees.

text.p: A Maine study group recommended the state seek to lure at least 14,000 retirees to Maine over the next few years.
The report said Maine needs to become more attractive to potential retirees by trimming taxes and providing greater educational opportunities.
The study found retirees pump dollars into the state's economy without being a major drain on resources.
